title: RoboKit: Accelerating Parallel Differentiable Optimization for Robot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.20185v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present RoboKit, a high-performance, general-purpose toolkit for parallel differentiable optimization in robotics, built on three principles: (i) Performance and flexibility: GPU-parallel multi-seed solvers pair sampling with versatile optimizers, running 2-60$\times$ faster than task-specific baselines across seven tasks; (ii) Geometry, rendering and physics: hybrid and coarse-to-fine representations accelerate collision, differentiable rendering and simulation, optimizing 4096 grasps in 2.97 s; (iii) Integration with learning: costs are differentiable and simulation is parallel, so RoboKit both distills optimization into policies and trains RL; distilled policies run 9-240$\times$ faster at comparable accuracy, and RL reaches a GPU baseline's scores up to 2.1$\times$ sooner on the same simulator.

translated_title: RoboKit：加速机器人学习的并行可微优化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了RoboKit，一个面向机器人领域的高性能、通用型并行可微优化工具包，它建立在三大原则之上：(i) 性能与灵活性：GPU并行的多随机种子求解器将采样与多种通用优化器相结合，在七个任务中比任务专用基线快2-60倍；(ii) 几何、渲染与物理：混合表示和由粗到细的表示方法加速了碰撞检测、可微渲染和仿真，可在2.97秒内优化4096个抓取；(iii) 与学习的集成：代价函数可微且仿真支持并行，因此RoboKit既可以将优化结果蒸馏为策略，也可以训练强化学习；蒸馏出的策略在相当精度下运行速度快9-240倍，而强化学习在同一仿真器上最多可比GPU基线提前2.1倍达到相同分数。
tldr: RoboKit是一个高性能的机器人并行可微优化工具包，通过GPU并行多种子求解器、混合几何表示和与学习的深度集成，实现比任务专用基线快2-60倍的优化速度，并能将优化蒸馏为快9-240倍的策略或加速强化学习训练。
en_tdlr: RoboKit is a high-performance toolkit for parallel differentiable optimization in robotics, achieving 2-60× speedups over task-specific baselines through GPU-parallel multi-seed solvers and hybrid geometric representations, while enabling policy distillation that runs 9-240× faster and RL training that converges up to 2.1× sooner.
